brotherhood-attitude.reason: A fixed term of the teaching, the brotherhood of man (71:4.16).

destiny.reason: Technical term: Finality of Destiny, Paradise destiny, Supreme Council of Destiny (106:7.3, 31:10.9).

energy.reason: Set in the papers' scheme of force, energy, and power with defined stages (42:2.12, 42:2.14).

error.reason: Set in the scheme of evil, error, sin, and iniquity (54:0.1).

eternal-life.reason: Fixed term of the gospel: survival through faith sonship and Adjuster fusion (0:8.11, 147:3.3).

eternity.reason: Defined as temporal everlastingness, the everlasting now, in the papers' time scheme (118:1.1).

evolution.reason: Set against the existential in their scheme of evolutionary worlds and Deity, not only biology (65:2.1, 58:2.3).

experience.reason: Defined as interplay of self with external reality; experiential versus existential is a fixed category (102:4.2).

faith.reason: Defined as recognition of the validity of spiritual consciousness (103:7.13).

force.reason: The Foreword assigns force its own broad meaning, refusing the usual definitions (0:6.2).

free-will.reason: A divine endowment and a fixed category of freewill creatures and of the Father's will (54:3.1, 0:3.21).

goodness.reason: One of the triad truth, beauty, goodness by which divinity is comprehensible (0:1.17).

identity.reason: Technical: identity, unlike personality, can attach to nonliving energy patterns and transfers to the soul (0:5.4).

impersonal.reason: A reality level: nonpersonal, subpersonal, prepersonal, responsive to personality (107:7.4).

inevitabilitiess.reason: Fixed term: the Trinity is the absolute inevitability, the Master Spirits subabsolute (16:1.1, 115:7.5).

infinity.reason: Philosophic term of the I AM; infinity can self-limit and express at all reality levels (105:1.8).

logic.reason: Defined as the synthetic truth-seeking progression of the unity of faith and reason (103:7.13).

love.reason: Defined as the desire to do good to others; the supreme relationship (56:10.21).

meanings.reason: Defined: meaning is what experience adds to value; part of facts, meanings, values (100:3.4).

morality.reason: Morality is an inalienable endowment of human personality, a level of mind in their scheme (16:7.1).

mortal-mind.reason: Material mind level that transmutes into the morontia soul through Adjuster cooperation (1:3.7, 111:3.2).

nonresistance.reason: Jesus' teaching given a specific meaning: nonresistance of selfish reaction, not passive tolerance of wrong (180:5.9, 140:8.4).

parts-and-the-whole.reason: A named cosmic principle: the progress of part and whole are linked (12:7.11).

perfection.reason: Divided into existential and experiential perfection, a goal of the ascension (54:2.2, 39:9.2).

philosophy.reason: Fixed place in the papers' scheme: mediates science and religion, the observation of observation (112:2.12, 103:7.4).

prayer.reason: A fixed teaching term, the great unifier of faith urges (132:3.10; Paper 91).

rebellion-spiritual.reason: Fixed term for the Lucifer rebellion and its isolation of worlds (54:0.1).

revelation.reason: Fixed scheme of epochal revelation versus evolutionary religion (92:4, 101:2.1).

science-philosophy-and-religion.reason: The three a priori insights of the cosmic mind, a fixed triad (16:6.4, 16:6.10).

selfhood.reason: Selfhood of personality dignity is a bestowal of the Universal Father (9:6.4; 112:5.20).

sovereignty.reason: Experiential sovereignty earned by Creator Sons through bestowal is a fixed term of their cosmology (21:3, 7:1.1).

space.reason: Own cosmology: pervaded and unpervaded space, space respiration, space potency (11:8.8, 12:5).

spiritual-growth.reason: Defined as awakening to needs, discernment of meanings, discovery of values (100:2.2).

spiritual-insight.reason: One of three inalienables of human nature, with scientific curiosity and moral intuition (16:7.1).

spiritual-unity.reason: Jesus' fixed teaching: unity from the common indwelling spirit, not uniformity of belief (141:5.1).

spontaneity.reason: Divine spontaneity is injected into the physical creation and shared in all personality (9:3.8, 5:6.9).

truth.reason: A spirit-discerned living reality on high spiritual levels, one of truth, beauty, goodness (180:5.2).

unity.reason: A cosmic concept: unity of Deity and the universe, the subject of Paper 56 (56:0.1, 8:6.6).

values.reason: Values are a realm of reality in their scheme, paired with meanings and facts (100:1.6, 196:3.10).

wisdom.reason: Defined as a capacity above knowledge that distinguishes human mind (101:6.4).
